The CockroachDB receiver collects metrics from a CockroachDB cluster by querying
[`crdb_internal`](https://www.cockroachlabs.com/docs/stable/crdb-internal.html) system tables.

## Prerequisites

- CockroachDB v22.1 or later
- A SQL user with `SELECT` privileges on `crdb_internal` tables

## Configuration

| Field                 | Type     | Default   | Description |
| --------------------- | -------- | --------- | ----------- |
| `connection_string`   | string   | (required)| PostgreSQL-compatible connection string. |
| `collection_interval` | duration | `30s`     | How often to scrape metrics. |
| `query_timeout`       | duration | `30s`     | Maximum duration for a single query. |
| `query_limit`         | int      | `100`     | Maximum rows returned per query. |
| `max_query_length`    | int      | `200`     | Maximum query text length in metrics (0 = unlimited, minimum 50). |

### Example

```yaml
receivers:
  cockroachdb:
    connection_string: "postgresql://user:password@localhost:26257/defaultdb?sslmode=verify-full"
    collection_interval: 30s
    query_timeout: 30s
    query_limit: 100
    max_query_length: 200
```

### CockroachDB Serverless

Some metrics rely on system tables that are not available on CockroachDB Serverless.
The following metrics are disabled by default and should only be enabled on
self-hosted or Dedicated clusters:

- `cockroachdb.ranges.total`
- `cockroachdb.ranges.under_replicated`
- `cockroachdb.ranges.unavailable`
- `cockroachdb.nodes.live`
- `cockroachdb.nodes.total`

To enable them:

```yaml
receivers:
  cockroachdb:
    connection_string: "postgresql://..."
    metrics:
      cockroachdb.ranges.total:
        enabled: true
      cockroachdb.ranges.under_replicated:
        enabled: true
      cockroachdb.ranges.unavailable:
        enabled: true
      cockroachdb.nodes.live:
        enabled: true
      cockroachdb.nodes.total:
        enabled: true
```

## Metrics

Details about the metrics produced by this receiver can be found in
[documentation.md](./documentation.md).
